# Joint sub-model 3 + 4 fit (deoxyosones + thiols)

Raw residual = predicted minus measured (dex), before any scale; 'after scale' subtracts each series' fitted calibration offset (absolute rows: none; 'free': the series' weighted mean; tau: its shrunk mean) and is what a done-test reads. A hold-out row of a scaled series takes the offset fitted on that series' fit rows; with none it is not scored.*
